subject: Vulnerability disclosure & abuse reporting - RFI response
messages:
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@fintrust.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@fintrust.io
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vulnerability disclosure & abuse reporting - RFI items

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our procurement due diligence we've attached a short RFI focused on vulnerability disclosure and abuse-reporting controls. Could you please provide answers to the items below by next Friday (Jun 27)? A consolidated PDF with any supporting artifacts would be ideal.

Top-line asks:
1) Primary channels for receiving abuse/vulnerability reports (email, webform, programmatic API, phone).
2) SLA for acknowledgement and initial triage (hours/days) and target remediation timelines by severity.
3) Evidence & telemetry retention policy for raw logs, call traces, and aggregated telemetry.
4) Triage & escalation workflow (on-call rotation, PagerDuty integration, executive alerts).
5) Policy for responsible disclosure, bug bounties, and DMCA takedowns.
6) Examples of reports handled and anonymized redaction practices.

We included our RFI template (RFI_questions_v1.pdf) for your convenience. If you prefer a call to walk through the items, we can schedule next week.

Best,
Alicia Turner
Head of Security Operations
FinTrust Financial

Attachments: RFI_questions_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@fintrust.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability disclosure & abuse reporting - RFI items

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear deck and deadline. We're assembling a consolidated response and supporting artifacts and will deliver a PDF by June 27. Below is a short summary so you have visibility while we finish the attachments.

Summary answers (high level):
- Channels: security@redwoodinference.com (monitored), webform at https://support.redwoodinference.com/abuse, and a programmatic intake endpoint (HMAC-authenticated webhook) for high-volume partners. Phone escalation available for P0 incidents (listed in escalation matrix).
- SLA: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours for all inbound reports; classification and first-triage within 4 hours for P0/P1, 24–72 hours for lower severities.
- Retention: raw request logs retained 365 days by default; enriched telemetry and aggregated metrics stored 540 days; evidence snapshots preserved for 365 days post-incident for compliance review.
- Triage & escalation: PagerDuty on-call rotation for first responders, runbook-driven triage, and executive alerts for incidents meeting our severity threshold. We keep an escalation matrix and playbooks.
- Responsible disclosure: public disclosure policy with safe-harbor (we accept reports through security@redwoodinference.com or via HackerOne/bug-bounty partners when applicable). DMCA and legal takedown handled through our Legal team; we provide takedown confirmations and timelines.

We'll attach: consolidated_vdar_response.pdf, vuln_disclosure_policy.md, abuse_reporting_flow.pdf, and the PagerDuty matrix. Rishi / Monica — can you confirm the on-call cadence and the retention numbers below?

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vuln_disclosure_policy.md (text), abuse_reporting_flow.pdf (pdf), consolidated_vdar_response.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability disclosure & abuse reporting - RFI items

Irene / Monica — quick clarifications and suggested wording for the RFI:

- Acknowledgement SLA: we should state '24 hours business day' and call out 12 hours for high-volume enterprise partners (we have a mechanized path).
- Triage: P0 (service-impacting abuse or exploit) => acknowledge <4h, P1 (high risk content misuse) => triage <12h. Escalation to SRE and legal within 4 hours for P0.
- PagerDuty: current on-call rotation is 7 days per engineer; escalation policy escalates to team lead after 30 minutes, then to Director after another 60 minutes. I'll attach the raw rotation CSV for your reference.
- Telemetry retention: logs (raw request/kv cache traces) 365 days; security audit logs 730 days; aggregated telemetry 540 days. For regulated customers we offer configurable retention via Dedicated/Private deployments.

Also note we redact PII before sharing incident snapshots externally, and we provide a 3-party audit trail for major incidents that includes timestamps, actions taken, and related runbook references.

Attachments: pagerduty_oncall_rotations.csv (csv), pd-escalation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

- Rishi
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@fintrust.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@fintrust.io
Date: 2027-06-27T16:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability disclosure & abuse reporting - RFI items

Hi Alicia — attaching our consolidated RFI response and supporting artifacts (see attached files). Summary highlights are below and the PDF contains the full Q&A, runbooks, and anonymized incident examples.

Key commitments:
- Acknowledgement window: 24 business hours (12 hours for enterprise partners on our mechanized intake).
- Triage/initial response: P0 <4 hours, P1 <12 hours, P2/P3 within 24–72 hours depending on complexity.
- Retention: raw logs 365 days; security/audit logs 730 days; aggregated telemetry 540 days. Configurable retention available for Dedicated/Private customers.
- On-call & escalation: PagerDuty with 7-day rotations; escalation matrix included. Executive alerts for severity-high incidents.
- Disclosure & takedown: we accept responsible disclosure reports via security@redwoodinference.com and support bug-bounty partner programs. Legal handles DMCA or law-enforcement requests; we can provide timeline evidence on request.

We've uploaded the artifacts to a shared Drive and provided a DocuSign link for the standard MSA addendum if you'd like a signed commitment on response SLAs. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute walk-through next week to go through the attachments.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: consolidated_vdar_response.pdf (pdf), abuse_reporting_flow.pdf (pdf), pd-escalation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
